purpose: NAICS codes for industries that match NorCal CARB Mobile's diesel fleet sweet spot. Use these to search Google Business Profile for similar companies. Current CRM customers must NEVER appear on cold-call lead lists — they belong on the recurring retest list.
sweet_spot_note: Best conversion: tree companies with 4–5 trucks, small mechanical/construction fleets (e.g. ARC Mechanical), local haulers. Avoid mega fleets with telematics (Frito-Lay, national LTL) unless you already have a relationship.

industries.label: Tree Service / Landscaping
industries.fleet_signal: chipper trucks, boom trucks, dump trucks — usually 14k+ diesel

industries.label: Concrete / Ready-Mix
industries.naics_name: Ready-Mix Concrete Manufacturing / Poured Concrete Foundation

industries.label: Asphalt / Paving
industries.naics_name: Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction / Asphalt Paving Mixture

industries.label: Local Trucking / General Freight
industries.naics_name: General Freight Trucking (Local / Long-Distance TL / LTL)
industries.fleet_signal: straight trucks and semis — core CTC market
industries.caution: Skip national LTL brands with telematics programs unless relationship exists

industries.label: Towing / Roadside / Heavy Recovery
industries.fleet_signal: HD wreckers and rollback trucks often 14k+

industries.label: Waste Collection / Transfer
industries.naics_name: Solid Waste Collection / Other Waste Collection / Materials Recovery
industries.caution: Larger waste cos often have in-house compliance

industries.label: Site Prep / Excavation / Drilling
industries.naics_name: Site Preparation Contractors / Drilling Oil and Gas Wells (adapt locally)

industries.label: Plumbing / HVAC / Mechanical Contractors
industries.naics_name: Plumbing, Heating, and Air-Conditioning / Electrical Contractors
industries.fleet_signal: service vans + occasional diesel box trucks / boom trucks — ARC Mechanical type

google_business_profile_search_template.description: Search Google Maps / Business Profile for each term + city. Export or copy results, then run naics_prospecting.py --dedupe against CRM.
example_queries: concrete contractor near San Leandro CA
dump truck hauling near Hayward CA
heavy duty towing near San Leandro CA

exclusion_rule: Any phone (digits-only) or company name that matches leads/retest-customers.csv OR Master CRM goes to RETEST list, never to cold-call lead list.
